assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: conceptual walkthrough illustration for a local router firmware guide, asset C "verify".
Primary request: Four distinct firmware file tiles on a desk beside a magnifying glass and a small check badge, evoking careful verification before an update.
Scene/backdrop: Seamless warm ivory desk and backdrop, minimal editorial studio setting.
Subject: Exactly four separate three-dimensional folded-corner file tiles, arranged with clean separation; simple abstract nonverbal marks distinguish them. A refined magnifying glass rests beside the tiles, with a small forest-green check badge nearby. This is a conceptual metaphor for careful review, not proof of cryptographic authenticity.
Style/medium: Refined editorial 3D paper-clay illustration, tactile matte paper and softly rounded clay forms, premium restrained detail.
Composition/framing: Landscape 3:2, gentle elevated three-quarter view, cohesive compact grouping with generous negative space and open margins.
Lighting/mood: Soft natural studio light, gentle contact shadows, calm and careful.
Color palette: Warm ivory #faf9f6, forest green #213c35, sage #7c8c81, restrained burnt orange #cc4d28 accents.
Constraints: No text, letters, numerals, logos, watermark, screenshots, real UI, cryptographic certificate claims, device hardware, physical pin mappings or port mappings. Keep file tile symbols purely abstract and nonverbal.

Use case: stylized-concept

Composition/framing: Landscape 3:2, gentle elevated three-quarter view, cohesive compact grouping with generous negative space and open margins.
